name: Arahitogami ni Koikogare
source:
You visited Shinto Shrines every day.
One day you eventually visit a shrine over a thousand times.
At that moment three gods appear before you. 
They tell you that they will grant any one wish of yours.
Now your long awaited desire to have a romantic relationship with your superior at work, Hikaru Abe, can come true!
Here begins a slapstick comedy romance that will make you laugh, cry, and enjoy a good fight scene!

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.nihonkaigai]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你每天都参观神社。
有一天，你最终会参拜一座神社一千多次。
就在那一刻，三位神出现在你面前。
他们告诉你，他们会满足你的任何一个愿望。
现在，你期待已久的与工作上司阿部光建立浪漫关系的愿望可以实现了！
一场让你笑、哭、享受精彩打斗场面的闹剧喜剧爱情就此展开！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.nihonkaigai]Google Play[/url]]
